body: There are guild for any content you play now so do whatever you like. I personally do dungeon and raid + world boss for orn

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Definitely the memory hunts. You can unlock one hunt per day, and they give a crapton of orns plus amities.


Towers are important too, for special classes, weapons and followers.


Dungeons are shorter and are often required to participate in events.

author: capfedhill
body: Collect a Diluted Mnemonic daily from the Oracle Temple and scan the guild shop for any possible good amities.

author: KevineCove
body: Raids for experience and gear, towers for classes and celestial weapons, battle dungeons for end of dungeon rewards (these are 1/1000 chance so they're the least important of the three if you're still working towards the level cap.)
